answer: Grab's deliveries GMV grew **faster in FY2025 than in FY2024**: it rose 21% year-over-year in FY2025 (from $11,724 million to $14,236 million) [Grab, FY2025, p.96], compared to 13% growth in FY2024 (from $10,365 million to $11,724 million) [Grab, FY2024, p.140].
